content.aboutPreview:
Thirumalaai Traders is a trusted wholesale grocery supplier in Erode with 25+ years of experience.
We supply quality grocery and food products to schools, colleges, industries, mills and grocery shops.
Our wide product range is carefully selected to meet everyday and bulk requirements.
We focus on delivering consistent quality at competitive wholesale prices.
With reliable sourcing and timely delivery, we support businesses and institutions with confidence.
Our experienced team understands the needs of bulk customers and provides dependable service.
We believe in building long-term relationships through quality, trust and commitment.
Serving Quality. Delivering Trust.

faqs.question: Do you supply in bulk?
faqs.answer: Yes. Bulk supply is our core business. We serve institutions, canteens, mills, factories and retail businesses with large-volume and recurring grocery requirements.

faqs.question: Do you supply to colleges?
faqs.answer: Yes, we are specialised suppliers to college canteens and kitchens, including several leading institutions in the region.

faqs.question: Do you supply to school canteens?
faqs.answer: Yes. We provide reliable, regular grocery supply to school canteens with quality products suited to institutional kitchens.

faqs.question: Do you supply to industrial canteens?
faqs.answer: Yes. Industrial canteens are one of our key segments, with scheduled deliveries and consistent supply for employee kitchens.

faqs.question: Do you supply grocery shops?
faqs.answer: Yes. We are a wholesale source for retail grocery shops, offering competitive wholesale pricing across our product range.

faqs.question: Can we request wholesale pricing?
faqs.answer: Yes. Please submit an enquiry through our website, call our office or message us on WhatsApp with your requirements and we will share our wholesale price list.

faqs.question: Do you provide regular supply?
faqs.answer: Yes. We support scheduled, recurring supply arrangements for canteens and institutions so your kitchen never runs short.

faqs.question: Do you deliver within Erode?
faqs.answer: Yes, we deliver across Erode including Karungalpalayam and surrounding areas. For locations outside Erode, please contact our sales team to discuss your requirement.

faqs.question: Can we enquire for large quantities?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Large-quantity enquiries are welcome. Share your approximate quantity and delivery location and our team will respond with details.

faqs.question: How can we contact the sales team?
faqs.answer: You can call our office at 93844 82007, reach our sales managers directly through the numbers on our Contact page, email us, or send us a WhatsApp message.

sections.subtitle: The Beginning
sections.body: Thirumalaai Traders began its journey with a simple vision — to supply quality grocery products at fair prices and build lasting relationships with our customers.

sections.subtitle: Building Our Network

sections.subtitle: Growing Stronger

sections.subtitle: Expanding Our Range

sections.subtitle: Modern Infrastructure
